test_fresh_final_disabled_by_default: test that GatewayStreamConsumer preserves the legacy edit path when fresh_final_after_seconds is set to zero
test_short_lived_preview_edits_in_place: test that a preview younger than the threshold uses normal in-place editing on finalize
test_long_lived_preview_sends_fresh_fina: test that a stale preview triggers a fresh message send and deletes the old preview on finalize
test_fresh_final_without_delete_support: test that fresh-final still works as a best-effort send when the adapter lacks delete_message
test_stream_consumer_config_default: test that StreamConsumerConfig fresh_final_after_seconds defaults to zero and is configurable
